content_sections.heading: About RCB
content_sections.text: The Regional Centre for Biotechnology is located at 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurgaon Expressway, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, Faridabad, Haryana. The post is under the Principal Investigator Dr. Ambadas B. Rode, Associate Professor.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: M.Sc. in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry or equivalent, with a National Level JRF eligibility test such as NET, GATE, GPAT, etc., qualified. Candidates with 2 years of experience in organic synthesis, purification and characterization will be preferred. Strong practical and theoretical knowledge in organic synthesis and in separation/purification techniques such as distillation, crystallization, extraction and chromatography. Experience in operating equipment used for chemical synthesis and purification, and in interpreting spectral data from techniques such as NMR, MS, IR and HPLC. Knowledge of safe lab practices and SOPs. Hardworking and a team player with interpersonal skills. Below 32 years. The notice does not print a date for counting age and does not list any age relaxation. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs. 30,600/- (Consolidated) per month. The duration is up to 6 months and can be extended depending on performance till the project duration.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RCB Senior Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Apply online through the application link given in the notice, by 25/11/2026 till 5:00 PM. Upload copies of the documents named below. For any query, contact the Principal Investigator by email at [email protected] . M.Sc. Degree Certificate Certificate of experience (if applicable) National Level JRF eligibility test certificate such as NET, GATE etc.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email on 01/12/2026 at 6:00 PM to appear in the online interview. The interview will be held at 10:00 AM on 07/12/2026. The notice does not describe how candidates are shortlisted.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Project Assistant vacancies are there at RCB?
faq.answer: There is one position, as the notice states "No. of Position: One".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the RCB Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 25 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the RCB Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: An M.Sc. in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry or equivalent, with a National Level JRF eligibility test such as NET, GATE or GPAT qualified. Two years of experience in organic synthesis, purification and characterization is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the RCB Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 32 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the RCB Senior Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 30,600/- (Consolidated) per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the RCB Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Apply online through the application link in the notice by 25 November 2026, 5:00 PM, and upload copies of the M.Sc. degree certificate, the experience certificate (if applicable) and the NET/GATE or similar JRF eligibility certificate.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for the RCB Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are informed by email on 1 December 2026 at 6:00 PM to appear in an online interview at 10:00 AM on 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the RCB Senior Project Assistant engagement?
faq.answer: The duration is up to 6 months and can be extended depending on performance till the project duration.

faq.question: Q9. Which project is the RCB Senior Project Assistant post for?
faq.answer: The post is for the project "Development and evaluation of a circular mRNA vaccine formulation against the Hepatitis C virus", with Dr. Ambadas B. Rode, Associate Professor, as Principal Investigator.

faq.question: Q10. Whom can I contact with queries about the RCB Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Queries can be sent to the Principal Investigator by email at [email protected].
